infobox.usage: Unlocks a cabin at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Rogue USEC workshop key (Workshop) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the workshop bunkhouse, located somewhere at the Rogue USEC base.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: This key opens a cabin that is located in the east of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Toolbox
- Weapon mods
- 1x Jacket
- Possible spawn of 6-STEN-140-M military battery (Under the table)
